typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		emplid as string,
		name as string,
		name_initials as string,
		name_prefix as string,
		last_name as string,
		first_name as string,
		middle_name as string,
		country as string,
		address1 as string,
		address2 as string,
		address3 as string,
		address4 as string,
		city as string,
		state as string,
		postal as string,
		phone as string,
		per_status as string,
		orig_hire_dt as timestamp,
		sex as string,
		age_status as string,
		mar_status as string,
		mar_status_dt as timestamp,
		birthdate as timestamp,
		us_work_eligibilty as string,
		military_status as string,
		smoker as string,
		smoker_dt as timestamp,
		bilingualism_code as string,
		health_care_state as string,
		lang_cd as string,
		disabled as string,
		country_code as string,
		effdt as timestamp,
		benefit_id as string,
		highest_educ_lvl as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'Declare @full_load varchar(1)  select  @full_load = full_partial_load from ps_hcm.cfg_table_load_parameter  select     	cast(emplid as varchar(15)) as emplid,  	name,  	name_initials,  	name_prefix,  	last_name,  	first_name,  	middle_name,  	country,  	address1,  	address2,  	address3,  	address4,  	city,  	state,  	postal = convert(varchar(12), replace(postal, char(9), \'\')),  	phone,  	per_status,  	orig_hire_dt,  	sex,  	age_status,  	mar_status,  	mar_status_dt,  	birthdate,  	us_work_eligibilty,  	military_status,  	smoker,  	smoker_dt,  	bilingualism_code,  	health_care_state, 	lang_cd,  	disabled,  	country_code,  	orig_hire_dt as effdt 	, alter_emplid as benefit_id                ,  \'A-Not Indicated\' as highest_educ_lvl from  ps_hcm.ps_personal_data WHERE @full_load = \'F\' or datepart(dw,getdate()) = 1 or orig_hire_dt >=dateadd(dd,-90, getdate()) order by emplid',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource	source(output(
		employee_key as integer,
		emplid as string,
		name as string,
		initial as string,
		prefix as string,
		last_name as string,
		first_name as string,
		middle_name as string,
		country as string,
		address1 as string,
		address2 as string,
		address3 as string,
		address4 as string,
		city as string,
		state as string,
		postal as string,
		phone as string,
		per_status as string,
		orig_hire_date as timestamp,
		sex as string,
		age_status as string,
		mar_status as string,
		mar_status_dt as timestamp,
		birthdate as timestamp,
		us_work_eligibility as string,
		military_status as string,
		smoker as string,
		smoker_dt as timestamp,
		bilingualism_code as string,
		health_care_state as string,
		lang_cd as string,
		disabled as string,
		country_code as string,
		effective_from as date,
		efective_to as date,
		email as string,
		ad_user_name as string,
		last_productive_pay_date as date,
		email_source as string,
		generation_key as integer,
		personal_email as string,
		benefit_id as string,
		highest_education_level as string,
		ethnic_group as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * from hr.dim_employee',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupdimemployeeLKPTABLE
OLEDBSource,LookupdimemployeeLKPTABLE lookup(OLEDBSource@emplid == LookupdimemployeeLKPTABLE@emplid,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookupdimemployee
Lookupdimemployee select(mapColumn(
		emplid = OLEDBSource@emplid,
		name = OLEDBSource@name,
		name_initials = name_initials,
		name_prefix = name_prefix,
		last_name = OLEDBSource@last_name,
		first_name = OLEDBSource@first_name,
		middle_name = OLEDBSource@middle_name,
		country = OLEDBSource@country,
		address1 = OLEDBSource@address1,
		address2 = OLEDBSource@address2,
		address3 = OLEDBSource@address3,
		address4 = OLEDBSource@address4,
		city = OLEDBSource@city,
		state = OLEDBSource@state,
		postal = OLEDBSource@postal,
		phone = OLEDBSource@phone,
		per_status = OLEDBSource@per_status,
		orig_hire_dt = orig_hire_dt,
		sex = OLEDBSource@sex,
		age_status = OLEDBSource@age_status,
		mar_status = OLEDBSource@mar_status,
		mar_status_dt = OLEDBSource@mar_status_dt,
		birthdate = OLEDBSource@birthdate,
		us_work_eligibilty = us_work_eligibilty,
		military_status = OLEDBSource@military_status,
		smoker = OLEDBSource@smoker,
		smoker_dt = OLEDBSource@smoker_dt,
		bilingualism_code = OLEDBSource@bilingualism_code,
		health_care_state = OLEDBSource@health_care_state,
		lang_cd = OLEDBSource@lang_cd,
		disabled = OLEDBSource@disabled,
		country_code = OLEDBSource@country_code,
		effdt = effdt,
		benefit_id = OLEDBSource@benefit_id,
		highest_educ_lvl = highest_educ_lvl,
		employee_key = employee_key,
		initial = initial,
		prefix = prefix,
		orig_hire_date = orig_hire_date,
		us_work_eligibility = us_work_eligibility,
		effective_from = effective_from,
		efective_to = efective_to,
		email = email,
		ad_user_name = ad_user_name,
		last_productive_pay_date = last_productive_pay_date,
		email_source = email_source,
		generation_key = generation_key,
		personal_email = personal_email,
		highest_education_level = highest_education_level,
		ethnic_group = ethnic_group
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LookupdimemployeeSelect
LookupdimemployeeSelect split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> LookupdimemployeeIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
LookupdimemployeeIsMatch@Match sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		{} = Param_30)) ~> update
LookupdimemployeeIsMatch@NotMatch sink(input(
		country as string,
		age_status as string,
		birthdate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		mar_status as string,
		city as string,
		military_status as string,
		prefix as string,
		orig_hire_date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		mar_status_dt as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		smoker as string,
		disabled as string,
		address4 as string,
		state as string,
		first_name as string,
		effective_from as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		smoker_dt as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		address3 as string,
		health_care_state as string,
		address2 as string,
		initial as string,
		address1 as string,
		sex as string,
		last_name as string,
		highest_education_level as string,
		middle_name as string,
		emplid as string,
		per_status as string,
		country_code as string,
		phone as string,
		lang_cd as string,
		name as string,
		us_work_eligibility as string,
		postal as string,
		benefit_id as string,
		bilingualism_code as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		country,
		age_status,
		birthdate,
		mar_status,
		city,
		military_status,
		prefix = name_prefix,
		orig_hire_date = orig_hire_dt,
		mar_status_dt,
		smoker,
		disabled,
		address4,
		state,
		first_name,
		effective_from = effdt,
		smoker_dt,
		address3,
		health_care_state,
		address2,
		initial = name_initials,
		address1,
		sex,
		last_name,
		highest_education_level = highest_educ_lvl,
		middle_name,
		emplid,
		per_status,
		country_code,
		phone,
		lang_cd,
		name,
		us_work_eligibility = us_work_eligibilty,
		postal,
		benefit_id,
		bilingualism_code)) ~> OLEDBDestination
